title: Character-aware BiLSTM toxicity classifier
summary: The classifier tokenizes lowercased comments into word and punctuation tokens, truncates to 200 tokens, and builds a training-only vocabulary from tokens occurring at least twice, capped at 120,000. Unknown tokens map to a dedicated ID. Word embeddings are combined through a learned gate with projected averages of hashed 3–5 character n-gram embeddings. Spatial dropout feeds two bidirectional LSTMs; masked mean and max pooling are concatenated and passed through two residual ReLU dense layers and a scalar logit head. It trains for three epochs with soft toxicity targets using Adam, linearly decayed learning rate, mixed precision, gradient clipping, and shuffled length-bucketed batches. It then refits the head and encoder using sampled identity/toxicity strata: a differentiable, confidence-weighted pairwise AUC composite plus a weighted BCE anchor. Inference batches by length and returns sigmoid probabilities for validation evaluation.
